title: Sitemap and llms.txt completeness: lastmod on forty static entries, circles and commerce caps, and town names in llms.txt at launch

source.ref: Whole-site audit 2026-11-16 (project thread, requested by Daniel). Confidence: CONFIRMED. Audit file: audit/FINAL-BUILD-AND-REPAIR-LIST-2026-11-16.md

detail:
EVIDENCE: app/sitemap.ts:243,283-337,378-379: only guide pages use GUIDE_LAST_MODIFIED; pricing, /for/<niche>, /vs, help categories have none. || app/sitemap.ts:113-116 caps and 81-110 explanation; readers clamp server-side (lib/commerce/products.ts, public_circles RPC LIMIT 200). || app/llms.txt/route.ts:252 uses listDensityCities(); FOUNDING_CITIES is never imported by app/llms*.txt (grep of FOUNDING_CITIES shows lib/jsonld.ts only).

WHY IT MATTERS: Google uses lastmod to schedule recrawls; at launch the pricing and door pages will change often and get slow recrawls. Omitting is honest but loses a signal. Not a launch problem (volumes are near zero) but circles will reach 200 first and the warning is log-only. AI crawlers fetching llms.txt get the place only as one phrase (FOUNDING_PLACE), not the towns.

FIX DIRECTION: Extend GUIDE_LAST_MODIFIED (lib/seo/guide-dates.ts) to pricing and /for doors and stamp it from the real edit date. Page the public_circles RPC and the listing readers, or move to a sitemap index split by section. Emit the founding towns from FOUNDING_CITIES in llms.txt and llms-full.txt alongside the dense cities.

2026-11-16 partial: lastmod now stamped on /pricing, /vs, each comparison, /for, each /for/<niche> and the new /north-county-san-diego hub (PAGE_UPDATED in lib/seo/guide-dates.ts); llms.txt now names the founding towns from FOUNDING_CITIES and links the hub, and llms-full.txt carries the same. STILL OPEN: paging past CIRCLE_SITEMAP_CAP = 200 needs an offset on the public_circles RPC (a migration, lib/discover.ts getPublicCircles) and offsets on the commerce readers; the probe's second clause stays red until then. Help category pages still carry no lastmod.

verify.note: Fails on 2026-11-16 (audit run). Passes when the fix lands. Audit-written probes are direction checks; retime only with Daniel's phrase.
